neighbours.label: a possessive determiner (our, its, their, her, my) in front of a noun
fire: We shipped the parts because our supplier closed its plant in June.
Please send the form, since our office handles all their claims.
The virus can pass control to her own server after this step.
The firm is shrinking, with its sales down again this quarter.
Here is my own theory about how the old script spread.
Usually our team answers within a day, and their manager follows up.
The attacker hides her tools inside their own shared folder.
Most nations protect our oceans and guard their fishing waters.
quiet: We shipped the parts because a supplier closed some plant in June.
Please send the form, since an office handles all such claims.
The virus can pass control to a remote server after this step.
The firm is shrinking, with sales down again this quarter.
Here is a new theory about how the old script spread.
Usually a clerk answers within a day, and a manager follows up.
The attacker hides some tools inside a shared folder.
Most nations protect the oceans and guard local fishing waters.
